title: Step 66-H integrated Content SEO Policy Storefront production and browser acceptance
description: MEDIUM-risk Step 66-H. Add a production-build acceptance gate spanning Step66 Article list/detail, SEO/structured data, sitemap/robots, approved static policy pages, fail-closed Contact, Archive and Stop-Sale. Exercise ready/empty/error/invalid-cursor states against an isolated authoritative API fixture, validate privacy/authority boundaries, and run Chromium/Axe RTL/responsive/reflow checks at 320px and 1200px when browser QA is available. No runtime product code mutation unless acceptance proves a defect.

dependencies.evidence: PR #349 exact-artifact Human Gate approved; merged; postmerge Canonical CI #1691, Phase A #1190, Storefront Quality #749 and CodeQL #826 SUCCESS; terminal Lock release comment 6107326647.

security_privacy: Contact has no direct submission form

legacy_verifier_repair.finding: Inherited Step62 browser acceptance read the Wishlist button label immediately after success-message visibility; React pending-state label could still be present for a short interval.
legacy_verifier_repair.repair: Test-only synchronization: wait for the final accessible button name after Wishlist removal before asserting aria-pressed and label. No Wishlist runtime code or authority is changed.

runtime_defect_repair.finding: Article Detail breadcrumb and related-article anchors rendered at ~17px block height, below the 44px minimum target required by the Step55/58 accessibility baseline.
runtime_defect_repair.repair: Add logical CSS-only 44px minimum target sizing and visible focus to Article Detail navigation/related links. No data, authority, business logic or component semantics change.

acceptance_criteria.description: Production-build acceptance exercises all Step66 public content/policy/catalog-state HTML routes plus sitemap.xml and robots.txt against isolated authoritative fixtures.
Article list/detail pass ready, empty, server-failure and invalid-cursor recovery; related-content failure does not fabricate or hide valid article detail.
Article detail preserves backend-owned title/description/canonical/robots and valid Article JSON-LD; hostile HTML in article body is rendered only as text.
Sitemap consumes bounded paginated article authority, includes canonical static/article URLs, excludes Archive/Stop-Sale, and robots.txt points to the canonical sitemap.
About/FAQ/Terms/Returns-Warranty approved content and fail-closed Contact render without invented direct submission, SLA, email or phone channel.
Archive and Stop-Sale pass ready/empty/error/invalid-cursor behavior; archive privacy fields remain absent; stop-sale remains dedicated-endpoint authority even when item is in_stock.

When browser QA is available, all nine Step66 HTML surfaces pass Chromium RTL/no-horizontal-overflow/one-H1/Axe WCAG automated checks at 320px and 1200px, with visible keyboard focus and 44px target checks.

Storefront verify and browser-quality chains include step66:acceptance while preserving all prior gates; no runtime application, Backend/OpenAPI/DB/dependency/Product Design/current-state mutation is introduced.

MEDIUM-risk closure requires exact-head Canonical CI, Phase A, Storefront Quality, deterministic Review, exact-artifact ACTIVE Lock, protected merge, exact-SHA postmerge verification and terminal Lock release; no Owner Human Gate required.

external_gate_evidence.rule: Step 66-H is MEDIUM risk; Human Gate is not required.
